messages:
maria: Quick sync: short bring-up for aspen-9b variants. Need a routing rec before product sync.

raj: drop the topline.

maria: Short summary: int6 looks like the production sweet spot. int4 cheapest but has long-context issues. Numbers from shortloop: 
- aspen-9b-int6: p50=82ms, p95=190ms, synth-qa delta=-0.6pp vs fp16-13b, throughput ~980 tok/s, est $0.78/1M tokens
- aspen-9b-int4: p50=70ms, p95=230ms, synth-qa delta=-2.9pp, throughput ~1200 tok/s, est $0.48/1M tokens
- base-13b-int8 (fallback): p50=140ms, p95=360ms, synth-qa delta=-0.3pp, throughput ~650 tok/s, est $1.10/1M tokens

olivia: int4 p95 > int6? probable KV cache cold-starts on long prefixes.

maria: confirmed. Cold-start spikes on multi-turn slices; a few n-gram hallucination cases in summarization.

tom: can we gate int4 with confidence? route hard cases to 13b?

maria: tested entropy threshold >3.2 -> reroute to 13b. Reduced recall loss for int4 by ~0.7pp, cost increase ~14% on that slice.

nate: recommended rollout split?

maria: propose: 65% -> aspen-9b-int6, 25% -> aspen-9b-int4 for short chats (<=80 tokens, low history), 10% -> base-13b-int8 fallback. Hijack on entropy>3.2.

raj: sample route config?

maria: 
```
routes:
  - name: cheap-chat
    model: aspen-9b-int4
    match:
      - query_length <= 80
      - user_history_tokens <= 200
    weight: 0.25
  - name: general
    model: aspen-9b-int6
    weight: 0.65
  - name: safety-fallback
    model: base-13b-int8
    match: entropy > 3.2 or response_length > 200
    weight: 0.10
```

olivia: add periodic warm probes for cheap-chat (1 probe per 5k active users) to keep KV cache warm and stabilize p95.

maria: will enable cached warm probes.

nate: blended unit-econ?

maria: ~0.65*0.78 + 0.25*0.48 + 0.10*1.10 = $0.72/1M tokens. p95 target <250ms for ~90% traffic.

raj: what quality risk to tell product?

maria: recommend: "~0.5-1.0pp expected QA delta vs fp16-13b under this routing; fallbacks protect high-risk slices."

ops-bot: deploy-canary: route config deployed to canary c-202505-01, 1% traffic, start=2025-05-01T14:12:00Z :rocket:

tom: monitor per-route cost, p95, synth-qa delta, entropy-hijack rate. Rollback cheap-chat if synth-qa drift >1.5pp.

maria: I'll publish a dashboard and a 6h canary runbook, will post results here after 6h. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
